suite.scope: First 12 named NNG4 theorems in source order; exploratory rehost, not the full upstream benchmark.

selection.policy: Source order only; no theorem-name, proof-success or difficulty selection.

candidate_profile.import_audit_source:
import Colony.Tactic
set_option maxHeartbeats 200000
run_meta do
  let env ← Lean.getEnv
  let candidateModules : List Lean.Name := [`Colony.Procedures.ListState, `Colony.Tactic]
  for (name, info) in env.constants.toList do
    if let some idx := env.getModuleIdxFor? name then
      if candidateModules.contains env.header.moduleNames[idx.toNat]! then
        match info with
        | .defnInfo _ | .opaqueInfo _ =>
          if ← Lean.Meta.isProp info.type then
            throwError "Imported proof-valued helper is prohibited: {name}"
        | _ => pure ()
candidate_profile.restriction: No explicit local theorem/example/helper proofs or proof-valued defs; compiler-generated data declarations allowed

assurance.label: Lean elaboration kernel; standard axiom allowlist; no independent external replay
assurance.security_boundary: Trusted pinned evaluator/configuration, reviewed main and compiler; no adversarial sandbox
